description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Two Rules Under the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanak Act, 35 of 2002
reasoning: The gazette content details rules for determining staff remuneration and a scheme for recruitment within the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka. This concerns public sector service conditions, salary scales, increments, performance appraisals, and recruitment procedures for a specific government commission. It fits the definition of a **Public Service Gazette** (Type 8), which covers public service recruitment, service conditions, benefits, and administrative instructions for public sector employees. The content does not involve government structural changes (Type 1), specific named personnel appointments (Type 2/3), or any of the other specialized categories like Land, Legal, or Commercial matters.
